stations.title: Catalogue page
stations.text: Every title, in the order people read.

captions: At Wrenhaven Scores, a director cannot find Psalm 23 on the catalogue page.
Psalm 121 comes first, and titles with a small letter or an accent sit after Zephyr.
You catch it in a test, sort the way a person reads, and test another language.
Now the page reads in order on every computer, whatever its language.
Same titles, same page. A director finds Psalm 23 where she looks.
